configuration.selected_by: training-only trial-grouped cross-validation, in an earlier step
configuration.eligibility_rule: target eligibility uses the selected lag, frozen for every reported model so all models share one validation sample set

procedure.normalization: fitted once on the complete training set and applied unchanged to validation
procedure.constant_baseline: predicts the mean training velocity for every sample and uses no neural data
procedure.ridge: fresh model fitted on the complete training set at the selected alpha
procedure.evaluation: each model scored once on validation; no tuning followed
procedure.metric: per-axis coefficient of determination, Pearson correlation, and root-mean-square error, each reported per axis and as the arithmetic mean of the axes

training_diagnostics.purpose: training-set fit quality, reported for the train-to-validation gap only and not a project result

not_accessed.held_out: not read while establishing the baselines
